title: Cursor Marketplace Manifest
description: Marketplace catalog read by Cursor at .cursor-plugin/marketplace.json in the repository root. Authored from the official Cursor plugin reference and the official plugin template; Cursor publishes no JSON Schema.
$comment: Provenance: authored (not upstream-vendored) 2026-09-08. Sources: https://cursor.com/docs/reference/plugins ; cursor/plugin-template/.cursor-plugin/marketplace.json ; real catalogs (tldraw/tldraw for metadata.pluginRoot, cloudflare/skills, huggingface/skills, NVIDIA/skills, wshobson/agents). The docs describe the entry source object only as "object with path and options" and leave the option set unspecified, so it is modeled as an object requiring path. When a per-plugin manifest exists, it is merged with the entry and manifest values take precedence.

url.description: Used in real catalogs; not in the docs field table.

pluginRoot.description: Prefix path for all plugin sources; a bare source name resolves under it.

variables.description: Variable schema; prefer the plugin manifest, whose values win when both are set.

source.description: Path to the plugin directory, or an object with path and options. Resolution: look for <source>/.cursor-plugin/plugin.json, merge it with this entry (manifest wins), then run component discovery inside the source directory.
